pr_title: [addons][PVR] PVR addon-API: Replace fixed size arrays with dynamic arrays
pr_body:
Replace all fixed size arrays in the PVR add-on C API with dynamically allocated arrays. Overcomes limitations we hit in the past, for example property values being to long to fit into the pre-defined fixed size arrays. Also saves memory when transferring data, thus increases performance.

All changes are implemented in the C++ APi wrapper, so add-ons using this wrapper (all of the add-ons in Kodi binary add-ons and many others, like pvr.waipu, pvr.zattoo, ...) only need to be recompiled and re-released, no code changes required.

Carefully runtime-tested on macOS, latest Kodi master, with pvr.hts and pvr.plutotv.

@phunkyfish  Best reviewed commit by commit. The first commits should "explain" the concept quite good.

fix #23903

## Bug report
Some DRM systems like Comcasts' mpx Platform send information like tokens as parameters in the URL and not in the headers. That means Widevine URLs can get very long. If they exceed 1024 characters it results in inputstream not working any more.
### Describe the bug

https://github.com/xbmc/inputstream.adaptive/blob/Omega/src/decrypters/widevine/WVCdmAdapter.cpp 
There the char buffer[1024]; is defined for the license url if I am not mistaken.
Visibly from the logs the URL e.g. in CurlFile::Open is truncated after 1024 characters.
The server answers with http response 400 Bad request resulting in inputstream.adaptive not working correctly and no video being displayed.
